scope.summary: SCN capability is cached per session generation: a NotGranted session probes DBMS_FLASHBACK once, appends one scn_capability_probe degraded audit, and records observed_scn null on each audited read without leaking an SCN error; a Granted session records an exact SCN per read; an empty SCN result is desync and not cached; V$DATABASE is never substituted.
out_of_scope: Desync classification (T2.2b / .7.3), ADB and dead-session recovery.

entry_points.name: oracle_query over an external MCP stdio client (W4 w4_runtime_issue46_scn_probe_cached)
entry_points.trace: No-grant disposable owner, 20 sequential reads: PASS on free23, xe21, xe18; exactly one scn_capability_probe FAILED (ORA-00904) audit and 20 SUCCEEDED oracle_query records with verdict_certificate.observed_scn = null; all replies isError=false. Assertion location checked: the same case run against a flashback-granted owner produced integer verdict_certificate.observed_scn 6147036..6147055 on its 20 reads, so the driver's null check is not vacuous and the granted principal gets an exact SCN per read.

limitations: In a full unscoped W4 lane the no-grant case is red: 148df67c grants DBMS_FLASHBACK to the shared W4O_ owner for the whole transport pass whenever the positive diff case is selected, so the issue46 case then runs as a granted principal. This is the unresolved ww2n3 harness defect, not a product defect; the case passes only in scoped runs.
The granted-principal exact-SCN proof comes from the verifier's combined run, not from a committed W4 assertion; no committed case asserts box 1.
